description: This file defines the class AOBH_BusinessHours, which manages business hours configurations for different days, including methods for retrieving, calculating differences, and manipulating business hours.

classes.name: AOBH_BusinessHours
classes.description: Represents business hours for specific days, providing methods for checking and adjusting business hours intervals.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether the bean implements a specific interface; always returns false in this class.

methods.name: areBusinessHoursSet
methods.description: Checks if business hours are configured, caching the result for efficiency.

methods.name: getBusinessHoursForDay
methods.description: Retrieves business hours for a specific day, caching results.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Returns an existing business hours object for the day or creates a new one.

methods.name: insideThisBusinessHour
methods.description: Checks if a given DateTime falls within the open and close hours.

methods.name: diffBusinessHours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in business hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: addBusinessHours
methods.description: Adds or subtracts a number of business hours to/from a DateTime object.

methods.name: insideAnyBusinessHours
methods.description: Checks if a given DateTime falls within any configured business hours.
